text:
Ravi K.: Hey all, day 1 question — what’s the fastest place to post: laptop provisioning errors, API keys, and product clarifications? Also would love a quick pattern for keeping slack quiet but not missing important alerts.

Emily Tran: Laptop/provisioning -> #help (use template: Name / Team / What you need / Urgency). API keys or secrets access -> DM the platform access lead or file a ticket in #eng-infra with logs. Product clarifications -> #product.

Jonah: Short pattern I use: 1) Single person -> DM. 2) Cross-team -> public channel. 3) If it spawns >3 replies -> move to thread. Reactions are great for ack.

Ravi K.: How to mute the bot churn? DeployBot spam is brutal.

DevEx Bot: Hi Ravi! Recommended flow: channel > View apps > DeployBot > set to "only notify on failures". Use `/onboard subscribe-digest` to get a DM summary instead of channel posts. For incident alerts, do not mute #eng-oncall or the @oncall role.

InfraBot: For infra requests include exact commands and error output. Example for #eng-infra: "Ravi K. / eng-runtime / need deploy role / error: permission denied: add-key". That format speeds triage.

Emily Tran: Pro tips: 1) Set personal keywords (your name, pager) so mobile only vibrates on important stuff. 2) Pin onboarding docs in channels. 3) Use threads for status updates so the channel stays readable.

Ravi K.: Thanks! Also—anyone want to be a setup buddy this afternoon?

Jonah: I can pair at 3pm PT. DM me.

OnboardBot: Welcome Ravi! If you want a buddy assigned run `/onboard assign-buddy` or reply "buddy please" and we'll match you. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/slack-guides

Ravi K.: Awesome. Appreciate the quick tips :thumbsup:
